## Specific task description

Task instruction: Catch the QR code payment sign from the table, rotate it, then set it back down

Task description: The target is the QR-code payment sign on the left side of the table, with a gray base and dark display. Pick it up, turn the front toward the desired orientation, then put it back on the table.

Success criteria: The payment sign's base is flat on the table again, with the sign standing normally and its QR-code face directed toward the robot at the front of the table (downward in the head-view image), no longer angled left or right. Both grippers are open and the sign is released.

## Execution tips

- Consider a flat upper panel area near the top edge but large enough for full pad contact, with fingers on front and back. Avoid corner-only grasping or base contact to reduce slipping and collisions.
- Match the gripper opening to the sign panel thickness and approach clearance. Before closing, confirm the fingers actually enclose the panel rather than merely overlapping in the image while both press on the same face.
- When rotating it, lift the entire base off the table first and leave room for its four corners to swing, avoiding scraping the table or brushing the green pump bottle behind it.
- Keep the base parallel to the tabletop during placement. Release only after confirming the base is supported to reduce tipping from releasing while holding only the upper part of the sign.
